What the polish changes

The vibe had a physical cause

Your note was accurate, and it wasn't the gestures: every stacked note in the long events carried its own bed of excitation noise, and summed uncorrelated noise beds read exactly like a recording-room floor. The page flick was pure filtered noise (reads as swish), and the room reflections sat a touch high on the longest sounds. The polished renders cut the per-note beds roughly in half, trim the reflection send on events, narrow the slate grain, and rebuild the page flip from fiber micro-crackle â€” a flip is many tiny snaps, not a swish. Measured: the noise floor between the musical partials drops up to 5.7 dB (crit) with the tone untouched.
